description: reconcile_fact_movements builds three tables per call and 88 of 28,382 calls fill any; ProductValidationWalk.checked in stale_dependency is never filled; the woken set in enqueue_dependents is empty 98-100% of the time; mem::take / unwrap_or_default on ProductDependencies and membership leave default tables behind. Build them only when needed, or pass a slice. Removes about 150k tables per parse call (538,281 -> 388,848); instructions -0.4% to -0.7%. Report what each temporary was for; delete any that turn out to have no reader. Proposal page: /Users/j5n/Workspace/compile-cost-round-two.html (https://claude.ai/artifact/4T5Lime7pQxKbCiKJqaJ8x). Spike (base c768670cd; port by reading, not by applying): /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/tables/stepZ.diff. Acceptance: stdout (interp and run), canonical dump, activation key counts and job counts identical to the base binary on /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/p/distinct1.fz, f761.fz (--top 1 --top 2), f765.fz (--max-top 3), /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/m/r6.fz, /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/l/lit16.fz; release instructions retired re-measured on base and change binaries built the same way; full gate.
